summary: The Real Brokerage Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting the consummation of its acquisition of RE/MAX Holdings through a multi-step arrangement and mergers. Real REMAX Group, a new entity, acquired all REMAX shares and Real itself, with Real shareholders receiving one Real REMAX Group share per post-consolidation Real share (10-for-1 consolidation). The deal closed on August 24, 2026, per the Merger Agreement dated April 26, 2026. Financing included a $550M term loan and $40M revolver from Morgan Stanley Senior Funding. Watch for integration execution and post-merger debt service.
